Welcome, reader!

Hi there, and welcome to my little corner of the internet.

I'm Shary — a writer drawn to ideas that don't fit neatly into one box. Here you'll find opinion essays on the things I can't stop thinking about, short stories about people living quietly at the edges, and math pieces that try to make the beautiful and abstract feel genuinely human.

I believe every idea deserves a proper home. I'm glad you found this one.

Feel free to look around.

Hello, I'm Shary.

I write because ideas deserve to live somewhere outside my head. My essays wander through culture and politics; my short stories follow people in the quiet margins; my math pieces try to make the abstract feel almost touchable. Everything here is written slowly, with care, and with the hope that it finds the reader who needed it.
